correctness.rationale: The result concerns the full unital monoid algebra. The word-count recurrence gives b_r=(x)_r, including b_(n+1)=0. For n=p this gives x^p-x=b_p, the sum of distinct full words. Every full word absorbs every basis word on the right, so all columns of L_b_p are the same nonzero vector and its rank is one; L_b_p^2=p! L_b_p=0 and x b_p=0 by the recurrence. The split annihilator T^2 product_(j=1)^(p-1)(T-j) forces all nonzero blocks to be simple and zero blocks to have size at most two, and T^p-T has rank one per size-two zero block. The integer matrix has characteristic-zero multiplicities n!/j! by the cited module formula and the derangement identity; independently, each word of length r acts as an idempotent of rank equal to the number of injective words on the remaining n-r letters. Traces of the falling factorials (L_x)_r then recover the same n!/j! by a triangular system. Reduction of the characteristic polynomial adds only the 0 and p multiplicities. The same annihilator before the collision has distinct linear factors, proving semisimplicity for n<p.
